about: GameTest classes whose method set keeps differing between two coverage maps of one commit by more than timer noise (tools/gate/covmap.py NOISE_*), because the path they take depends on timing. The determinism check (gate.py covmap-compare, the weekly map's two replicas) ignores these and only these. Noise is spread: each run a different handful of classes goes over the per-class allowance and is named in the refresh's summary; add a row only for a class that keeps appearing there, with what was measured, and remove it when it stops. docs/GATE_B.md, 'The coverage map'.
